tasks.label: migrate-sqlite
tasks.command: DB_PROVIDER=sqlite npx prisma migrate dev --name init_sqlite --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && DB_PROVIDER=sqlite node prisma/seed.js

tasks.label: migrate-sqlite-v2
tasks.command: DB_PROVIDER=sqlite SQLITE_URL="file:./dev.db" npx prisma migrate dev --name init_sqlite --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma 2>&1

tasks.label: force-restart-backend
tasks.command: taskkill //F //IM node.exe 2>&1 | head -3; sleep 2; node src/index.js

tasks.label: kill-restart-backend
tasks.command: netstat -ano | grep ':4001' | awk '{print $5}' | xargs -I {} taskkill //PID {} //F 2>&1; sleep 2 && node src/index.js &
